purpose: Permanent record of adversarial Parser V2 failures discovered from real-invoice-derived mutations. A resolved entry must retain a regression lock so the failure class cannot silently return.
workflow: Record the exact mutation/failure class before changing parser code.
Fix the generalized root cause; do not hard-code supplier or invoice identifiers.
Only after the failed variant passes, run the full regression suite.
If the failed variant still fails, overall status remains NOT READY.

cases.mutation: Invoice number represented as a two-token value after the label: 'Invoice Number INV LTA-00215840'.
cases.observed_failure: Parser V2 header resolver reduced the tail to the first token and returned the invoice number blank.
cases.root_cause: identifierFromTail accepted only one token and required that token itself to contain a digit.
cases.generalized_fix: Allow a short alphabetic prefix plus one digit-bearing identifier token while rejecting arbitrary trailing prose.

cases.mutation: Place an equipment table and a later service table on the same page, with the first table subtotal physically closer to the second table header than the second table subtotal.
cases.observed_failure: Parser V2 could infer the later table direction upward and miss the second table body.
cases.root_cause: detectDirection preferred the nearest total without proving that table body evidence existed between the header and that total.
cases.generalized_fix: When totals exist on both sides of a header, score each side using body evidence between header and total; use distance only as a tie-breaker.
cases.expected: Detect both tables; account for 1 equipment row + 1 service row; promote only the equipment row.

cases.mutation: OCR places 'Invoice No:' on one line and VIN17-032365 on the next line.
cases.observed_failure: Parser V2 left invoice_number blank despite the value being visible in a targeted OCR pass.
cases.root_cause: Header resolver required invoice label and identifier to share one OCR line.
cases.generalized_fix: Accept only a tightly adjacent identifier-like line after an invoice label, stopping at other known header labels.

cases.mutation: Reference ends with 'V17-' immediately before the adjacent printed date 12/08/22.
cases.observed_failure: Date matcher combined reference digits with the date and produced 17/12/08 (2008-12-17).
cases.root_cause: Date regex had no boundary preventing a match from starting inside an alphanumeric/reference identifier.
cases.generalized_fix: Extract bounded date tokens that cannot start inside letters, digits, slash, dot or hyphen sequences.

cases.mutation: Projector specifications, warranty and serial rows appear after its price row and before the next priced AVS-320A row.
cases.observed_failure: Those continuation rows were pulled forward into the next AVS product description.
cases.root_cause: Row builder assigned all rows since the previous economic anchor to the next anchor even when the next anchor already contained its own description.
cases.generalized_fix: Prefer the economic anchor's own description when present; use prior rows only when the anchor lacks a usable description.

cases.mutation: OCR/geometry places vendor word 'Abtus' inside the product-code column next to AVS-320A.
cases.observed_failure: SKU was corrected to AVS-320A but the item name lost the vendor word.
cases.root_cause: Code-column boundary slightly overlapped the description column; trimming the SKU discarded the remainder.
cases.generalized_fix: When a strong SKU is the first token in a code cell, preserve a safe nonnumeric remainder as description spill.
cases.expected: AVS-320A / Abtus AVS320 HDMI Control panel

cases.observed_failure: Parser V2 classified the priced Active Speaker row as service solely because the code contained SALES.
cases.root_cause: Numeric accounting-code rule treated SALES the same as installation/labour/service.
cases.generalized_fix: SALES alone is not service evidence; let strong physical-equipment identity plus verified economics determine disposition.
cases.expected: 60100-SALES Abtus Active Speaker in pair -> equipment
cases.permanent_regression_lock: tests/run-regression.cjs — SALES disposition and aerospaceRawV2 speaker assertions

cases.mutation: Thin horizontal interference lines cross both invoice number and date. One OCR pass reads ENH7-032365 while other invoice-aware OCR passes cannot corroborate it.
cases.observed_failure: Parser V2 initially accepted ENH7-032365 as a resolved invoice number.
cases.root_cause: A single OCR source meeting the score threshold could resolve an invoice identifier even when other OCR passes saw the field but did not confirm that value.
cases.generalized_fix: For OCR-only invoice identifiers with support=1, require corroboration when multiple OCR sources observe the invoice label; otherwise leave unresolved.
cases.expected: invoice_number blank / Review required, never ENH7-032365

cases.mutation: Touching-character effect + line interference + blur produces VING932365- from one OCR mode while other modes cannot recover the number.
cases.observed_failure: Parser V2 initially accepted VING932365- as the invoice number.
cases.root_cause: Same single-source OCR acceptance weakness as ADV-008 under more severe degradation.
cases.generalized_fix: Same OCR corroboration guard; one unconfirmed damaged reading cannot auto-fill the field.

cases.mutation: OCR alternates between VIN17-03236S and VIN17-032365.
cases.observed_failure: Before the majority refinement, a 2-to-1 correct OCR majority still fell back to Review because the conflict rule ignored source support.
cases.root_cause: Conflict handling compared confidence scores but not independent corroboration count.
cases.generalized_fix: For invoice IDs only, two or more independent sources agreeing on one value can outweigh one conflicting OCR source; 1-vs-1 still fails closed.
cases.expected: single S misread -> unresolved; two correct 5 readings vs one S -> VIN17-032365
